decisionReason: No reviewed public row exactly matches both the NutriMind price commodity identity and the catalogue food identity plus preparation state. Loading a nearby factor would silently transfer yield evidence across food form, cut, preparation, or geography.

sources.agencyName: Department of Science and Technology - Food and Nutrition Research Institute
sources.publicationTitle: Yield Factors for the Calculation of Nutrient Content of Cooked or Prepared Foods
sources.geographyApplicability: Foods sampled from selected Metro Manila markets and supermarkets, Philippines
sources.factorMeaning: Cooked or prepared weight relative to the corresponding pre-cooking weight for specified boiling, sauteing, frying, or oven-broiling procedures.
sources.foodsAndPreparationsReviewed: Abstract reports 173 factors across meat, fish, vegetables, and cereals; item-level identities, preparation protocols, and values are absent from the public abstract.
sources.uncertainty: No row-level values, sample counts, dispersion, or exact identity/preparation table is publicly available in the reviewed artifact.
sources.omissionReason: A factor cannot be verified or redistributed from an abstract alone. Obtain the item-level table and written reuse terms from DOST-FNRI before review.

sources.agencyName: United States Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service
sources.publicationTitle: Food Buying Guide for Child Nutrition Programs
sources.geographyApplicability: United States institutional food purchasing and preparation
sources.factorMeaning: Purchased quantity to specified edible or cooked serving yield; the guide also documents division by yield to calculate required purchased quantity.
sources.foodsAndPreparationsReviewed: Official rows exist for specific carrot, cucumber, tomato, and potato forms, including trim/peel/cut/drain details.
sources.uncertainty: The official guide warns that food quality, handling, equipment, cooking, and holding affect yield. NutriMind target names omit the cut, peel, drain, and institutional preparation details needed for an exact row match.
sources.omissionReason: US product specifications and preparation states are not exact matches for the Philippine PSA/FNRI identity pairs in the current basket.

sources.agencyName: United States Department of Agriculture, Agricultural Research Service
sources.publicationTitle: USDA Table of Cooking Yields for Meat and Poultry, Release 2
sources.geographyApplicability: United States sampled retail meat and poultry products
sources.factorMeaning: One hundred multiplied by cooked hot weight divided by raw weight, reported by exact cut and cooking method.
sources.foodsAndPreparationsReviewed: Meat and poultry cuts with defined cooking methods; the current NutriMind chicken-breast target has no matching cooking preparation in the selected price-to-catalogue pair.
sources.uncertainty: Rows can include minimum, maximum, sample size, and standard deviation, but transfer to a different cut or preparation is unsupported.
sources.omissionReason: No exact current price commodity plus catalogue preparation pair was established.

sources.agencyName: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations / INFOODS
sources.publicationTitle: FAO/INFOODS Guidelines for Converting Units, Denominators and Expressions
sources.factorMeaning: Methodological rules for explicit units, denominators, density-dependent volume/mass conversions, and documented conversion provenance.
sources.foodsAndPreparationsReviewed: Methodology rather than an item-level yield table.
sources.uncertainty: Does not itself supply exact NutriMind food conversion factors; density and preparation-specific evidence remain required.
sources.omissionReason: Used to define validation policy, not as numerical evidence.

sources.agencyName: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations / INFOODS
sources.factorMeaning: Methodological guidance for matching food identity, edible portion, and preparation before reusing compositional data.
sources.foodsAndPreparationsReviewed: Methodology rather than an item-level conversion table.
sources.uncertainty: Does not authorize inference between raw and cooked food identities.
sources.omissionReason: Used to define exact matching policy, not as numerical evidence.

requiredBeforeImport: Obtain the authoritative row-level artifact from the publishing agency.
Record written redistribution terms that apply to the artifact.
Store the unchanged artifact outside source control when redistribution is restricted.
Record its lowercase SHA-256 checksum and retrieval timestamp.
Match source food form, cut, edible basis, preparation, geography, and destination FNRI identity exactly.
Have a named reviewer approve an append-only evidence revision.
acquisitionWorkflow.contactRequest: Request the full 173-row Philippine yield-factor table, methodology, uncertainty fields, and reuse terms from DOST-FNRI.
